title: Competitive Landscape in Digital Payments: Stripe vs Adyen vs PayPal
content:
Observation: the most relevant competitive set for Stripe includes Adyen, PayPal/Braintree, and Block. The market is consolidated enough that pricing, enterprise wins, and product breadth matter more than simple presence.

Stripe wins when merchants value fast integration, developer experience, and a broad software layer around payments, especially in SaaS, marketplaces, and internet-native businesses.

Stripe loses when buyers care most about price, global enterprise acquiring efficiency, or an established consumer wallet. Adyen is the sharpest enterprise comparison because of its unified commerce and vertically integrated acquiring stack. Braintree matters because PayPal and Venmo distribution can make price-plus-wallet access hard to ignore.

Watch items: enterprise upmarket wins, pricing pressure versus Adyen and Braintree, and whether Stripe's broader suite keeps it differentiated beyond core payment processing.
